en.p: A cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $1$ satisfies

For the origin $\mathrm{O}$ and the point $\mathrm{P}(3,\,f(3))$, let $\mathrm{Q}$ be the point, other than $\mathrm{P}$, where segment $\mathrm{OP}$ meets the curve $y=f(x)$. Let $A$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$, the $y$-axis, and segment $\mathrm{OQ}$, and let $B$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$ and segment $\mathrm{PQ}$. What is the value of $B-A$? [4 points]
